summary.zh: Jira 的 JQL、工作流与自动化配置
summary.en: Write JQL, fix workflows, add custom fields and automation.

description.zh: 编写和优化 JQL 查询，设计工作流、自定义字段与自动化规则，搭建看板和仪表盘。适合需要快速查单、配置审批流或修复失效规则时使用。需要在 Jira 中具备项目或站点管理权限。
description.en: Writes and tunes JQL, designs workflows, custom fields and automation rules, and builds dashboards. Good when you need a fast query, a new approval flow or a broken rule fixed. Needs project or site admin rights in Jira.
